title: Skin Care for Nashik Weather: A Routine for Dry Summers, Ghat Monsoons and Cold Winter Mornings
ex: Hot dry summers, a monsoon that pours in the ghats and cold, dry winter mornings: a simple, season-by-season skin care routine for people living in Nashik.
rt: Skin Care for Nashik Weather by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Nashik weather: sun care for hot dry summers, fewer layers in the monsoon and a richer routine for cold, dry winter mornings on the plateau.
quick: Nashik is hot and dry from March to May, rainy from June to September and cool to cold and dry from November to February. Use a gentle face wash and broad-spectrum sunscreen all year, a thin gel moisturiser in the warm months, and a richer night cream and lip balm in winter.
facts: Nashik is on a plateau in north Maharashtra, at the edge of the Western Ghats
March to May is hot and dry with strong sun
The monsoon runs June to September and is far heavier in the ghats around Igatpuri and Trimbak
Winter mornings are among the coolest in Maharashtra
